name: inline_cta_list_select_option
label: Inline CTA List: Select Option
inline_help_text: Add your CTA internal name to the HubDB Table 'Endless Customers Learning Center Global CTA List' (https://app.hubspot.com/hubdb/145335/table/142827335). All CTA settings should be configured in the global module named 'Learning Center Global Inline CTA Library' found in the sidebar of the modules added to this page.
